## From the Steel City to Vesuvius

Hello! My name is Caio, and I am a Brazilian researcher originally from Volta Redonda, Rio de Janeiro — a city widely known in Brazil as the *Steel City*. I am currently a Postdoctoral Researcher at the **Scuola Superiore Meridionale (SSM)** in Naples, Italy, not far from the slopes of Mount Vesuvius.

My academic journey has taken me across different areas of mathematics and computational science. I hold a **B.Sc. in Mathematics** and an **M.Sc. in Computational Modeling in Science and Technology**, both from the Fluminense Federal University (UFF), Brazil, as well as a **D.Sc. in Computational Modeling** from the National Laboratory for Scientific Computing (LNCC), Brazil.

I have always been curious about learning new tools, exploring new problems, and moving across disciplinary boundaries. This curiosity has shaped a multidisciplinary research path, bringing together mathematics, probability, optimization, control theory, computational modeling, and applications in different scientific domains.

Today, my research interests lie mainly in **stochastic control, applied probability, distributionally robust optimization, Markov jump systems, stochastic games, mathematical finance, and decision-making under uncertainty**.
